worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.summary: Gather sunlight into the body while standing still, then release it as a piercing beam along a straight line: every enemy in the corridor takes a hit, and the grass the beam crosses is scorched for a while. In strong sunlight it fires at once with no gathering; in rain it is half as strong and gathers more slowly.
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.use.0: Pierce a line across open ground
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.use.1: An unannounced heavy hit in clear weather
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.use.2: Leave a visible scorched trail on the grass
The beam deals %1$s special damage to each target it strikes.
The beam reaches %1$s blocks, is %2$s blocks wide (half-width) and pierces up to %3$s bodies; blocks stop it.
A struck target is pushed %1$s blocks along the beam; grass the beam crosses turns to scorched earth and grows back after %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.stance.broad: Diffuse: a wider band that sweeps several enemies in a row, but each hit is weaker.
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.stance.focus: Focused: a narrower band with a stronger single hit, at the cost of missing enemies standing side by side.
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s it consumes %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and cools down for %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the beam power steps up with level.
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the power steps up again and it pierces 1 more body.
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.growth.2: At level %1$s the cooldown from commit drops to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.preference.b: On (diffuse): a wider band (x1.6) that pierces up to 3 more bodies, but each hit is x0.66 and recovery/cooldown cost 2/3 ticks more; good against enemies in a row. Off (focused): a narrower band (x0.7) with a stronger single hit; good for focusing one target.
worldcombat.skill.solarbeam.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first instead of starting the gather; higher means it opens fire from further away.
Inside this distance the companion lowers its firing priority so it does not stand gathering within reach; 0 means it fires even point-blank.
On: prefers a target whose corridor holds more enemies, so one beam pierces more; off: ranks by ordinary ranged priority.
On: raises priority while standing in strong sunlight, when the move fires at once with full power; off: weather is ignored.
